title: Step sequencer: timing-protocol runner and LATE_DRAW threshold spec
purpose: Provides the run_protocol.json spec and a validate_protocol.js checker that enforces Scout's variable-isolation order (stable BPM before ramp), defines a numeric LATE_DRAW threshold (≤5% of entries), and separates visual-identification errors from timing-log outcomes. Extends Scout's check_cursor_sync.js without duplicating it. Source only; no browser execution performed.
